doc.heading: The check
lines: * X2: no half-empty columns. Fails if any column in a market map or feature
* matrix has half or more of its cells empty. Empty means no value: blank, a dash, or a cell that
* starts with N/A, Not disclosed (or specified, available, reported, listed,
* publicly disclosed), Undisclosed, Unknown, None, TBD or Privately held, with
* or without a note after it ("N/A (Private)", "Undisclosed (Subsidiary)").
* In a column that should hold a figure (revenue, valuation, users and so on),
* a word with no number in it, such as "Private" or "Internal / AWS cloud",
* is empty too. Code check. Trace code 8.
/** A cell that starts with one of these says there is no value, whatever note follows it. */
/** Column names that call for a figure. */
/** Words that stand in for a figure when there isn't one. */
export function isEmptyCell(v: unknown, column = ""): boolean {
/** Columns (name → cell values) of a market map or feature matrix; [] for other cards. */
export function cardColumns(card: OutputCard): { name: string; cells: string[] }[] {
if (!columns) return { name: "x2", score: 1, metadata: { reason: "No map or matrix columns to check." } };
if (!half.length) return { name: "x2", score: 1, metadata: { reason: `All ${columns} column(s) are more than half filled.` } };
return { name: "x2", score: 0, metadata: { reason: `Half-empty column(s): ${half.join("; ")}.` } };

bullets: Starts with N/A, Not disclosed, Undisclosed, Unknown, None, TBD or Privately held, with or without a note after it
“Private” or “Internal” with no number, in a column that should hold a figure
